name: Inter-Caste Marriage Assistance
full_name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Ninaivu Inter-Caste Marriage Assistance Scheme
summary: Money and a gold coin for couples marrying across caste. No income limit.
benefit_note: ₹25,000 — ₹15,000 by direct transfer and ₹10,000 as a National Savings Certificate — with an 8 gram 22 carat gold coin. ₹50,000 in total for graduates and diploma holders.
how_to_apply: Collect proof of the marriage and community certificates for both partners.
Apply through the Social Welfare Office for your district.

Taken from the Tamil Nadu Social Welfare Department marriage assistance page on 2026-08-09.
NO INCOME CEILING — stated explicitly on the official page.

NOT MODELLED: the two categories. The page describes Category I as SC/ST marrying anyone, and Category II as a forward or unreserved person marrying someone from BC or MBC. Those are different combinations of two people's castes, and the profile only holds one person's. Expressing this properly needs a partner_category field — decide whether that is worth collecting before this ships.

The Class 10 condition is written as a rule, but the page also says 'no minimum educational qualification stipulated' for higher categories. Those two statements conflict as extracted. Resolve against the government order before marking this verified — as written, the rule may produce false negatives.
NOT MODELLED: that a marriage is actually taking place. Same false positive as the other marriage assistance schemes.
SENSITIVE. Caste and marriage are both sensitive; is_intercaste_marriage must be asked inside this scheme's own flow only.
